subtitle: One-on-one notes your AI writes up after each meeting.
about: A running note for meetings with one person, with topics for next time, follow-ups and past conversations. Add topics yourself during the week, then tell your AI how the meeting went to write it up.

ask.prompt: Set up the one-on-one notes template in my Pinto Notes.

slides.label: Write up a 1:1
slides.you: It's with Emma. We had it Monday: on-call was rough, and she wants to lead the spring launch. I said I'd find her a mentor.
slides.ai: Added 1:1 with Emma, 16 November, and the mentor under Follow-ups.
slides.alt: The 1:1 with Emma written up, with follow-ups

slides.label: Next week, before the 1:1
slides.you: My 1:1 with Emma is in ten minutes. What did I promise her last time?
slides.ai: To find her a mentor before this 1:1. It's still unticked.

slides.label: Use it yourself
slides.note: Or tick and edit it yourself.
slides.alt: 1:1 notes as it starts, ready to fill in
